zh-CN.title: 大慈恩寺
zh-CN.subtitle: 玄奘译经与长安佛教制度的关键场所
zh-CN.shortSummary: 大慈恩寺是理解玄奘、译经、寺院网络和长安城市空间之间关系的核心机构条目。
curatorialDescription: 寺院不是静态背景，而是人员、文本、物件、赞助和仪式活动交汇的制度节点。
本条暂以机构级别呈现，具体大雁塔、译经院和藏经设施将拆分为地点与对象条目。
zh-CN.researchNote: 需要补充寺院沿革、译经场所、参与者和考古或图像记录的逐条来源与权利信息。

en.title: Great Ci'en Monastery
en.subtitle: A key site for Xuanzang's translation work and Chang'an Buddhist institutions
en.shortSummary: Great Ci'en Monastery is a core institutional entry for connecting Xuanzang, translation, monastic networks and Chang'an's urban space.
curatorialDescription: A monastery was not a static backdrop but an institutional node where people, texts, objects, patronage and ritual activity met.
This record stays at institution level; the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, translation spaces and manuscript holdings will become separate place and object records.
en.researchNote: Monastery history, translation sites, participants and archaeological or image records still require item-level sources and rights information.
